interpretation.requested_and_harmless: All five accept both routes; selected tests execute without skips.
interpretation.old_active_no_decoy_and_old_hook: Both Develop sources reject both routes. Pure, base and merged accept.
interpretation.wrong_inactive_decoy: All sources reject via inherited topology. Candidate additionally fails the newly added exact all-action-reference equality assertion; prior newly added whole-file regex passes because the disabled decoy supplies the requested text.
interpretation.mechanism_limit: Candidate asserts the complete repository-discovered setup-python reference list equals exactly the requested singleton; it does not bind that list to the active named owner and rejects extra references. Valid env mapping is accepted. These controls support measured pin discrimination and a narrower assertion than prior whole-file presence, but no general semantic-owner parser, dynamic-condition coverage or distinct treatment causality.
interpretation.base_control: Base source remains original; requested control upgrades only the two configuration pins. Base acceptance is a legacy test baseline, not a production upgrade or false base-positive claim.
interpretation.route_limit: One configured clean/compiler invocation per source, then direct relevant module execution and exact configured Node discovery phase with unchanged compiled output. This is not 50 full npm test invocations, fresh compilation per control, hosted lint, or check-dist.

cost.proposal_and_blind_cost: Retained separately in sealed-raw-result.json; no diagnostic savings inference.

independent_reconciliation.shared_dependencies: Execution runner verified full tree at setup and completion; packaging binds the recorded digest without rereading shared cache.

control_definitions.requested: Upgrade only active pre-commit/Setup Python uses to requested v7.1.0 commit and unique Markdown repository revision to v0.24.0. Keep original test sources.
control_definitions.old-active-no-decoy: Requested control with owning Setup Python uses restored to v7.0.0 commit, no extra step.
control_definitions.wrong-inactive-decoy: Old active Python plus a new final step in the same owning job: if ${{ false }}, requested setup-python pin and Python3.15.
control_definitions.harmless-empty-env: Requested control plus env: {} between owning setup uses and with.
control_definitions.old-markdownlint: Requested control with only unique Markdown repository revision reverted to v0.23.3.
control_definitions.semantic_check: Separate assessor YAML parser proves pre-commit job and Setup Python owner, no owner condition, Python3.15, unique exact Markdown repository/hook identity, expected difference per control and deep equality of every other parsed property.
